title: Locality of approximate tangent planes (Simon Ch. 3, Remark 1.5(2), Thm 1.6 ⇒)
statement: Let n, ℓ ≥ 0, A, N ⊆ ℝ^{n+ℓ} Borel with Hⁿ(A) < ∞ and Hⁿ(N) < ∞ (Hⁿ = μHE[n]), and P a map from ℝ^{n+ℓ} to linear subspaces such that, for every x ∈ N, P(x) is the approximate tangent space of N at x (Simon Ch. 3, Def. 1.4; Chapter03.HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n N x (P x)). Then for Hⁿ-almost every x ∈ A ∩ N, P(x) is the approximate tangent space of A at x. (Simon Ch. 3, Remark 1.5(2) / proof of Theorem 1.6 '⇒'.)
lean_statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (A N : Set (Amb n ℓ)) (P : Amb n ℓ → Submodule ℝ (Amb n ℓ)), MeasurableSet A → MeasurableSet N → (μHE[n] : Measure (Amb n ℓ)) A < ⊤ → (μHE[n] : Measure (Amb n ℓ)) N < ⊤ → (∀ x ∈ N, Poincare.SimonGMT.Chapter03.HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n N x (P x)) → ∀ᵐ x ∂(μHE[n] : Measure (Amb n ℓ)).restrict (A ∩ N), Poincare.SimonGMT.Chapter03.HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n A x (P x)
